_meta.indication: SYLVANT is indicated for the treatment of patients with multicentric Castleman's disease (MCD) who are human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) negative and human herpesvirus-8 (HHV-8) negative.

pivotal_trials.design: International, multicenter, randomized (2:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled study comparing siltuximab plus best supportive care (BSC) to placebo plus BSC, infused every 3 weeks; randomization stratified by concomitant corticosteroid use.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with multicentric Castleman's disease (MCD) who are HIV-negative and HHV-8-negative.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Durable tumor and symptomatic response: tumor response (complete or partial by modified Cheson criteria) assessed by independent review plus complete resolution or stabilization of MCD symptoms, sustained for at least 18 weeks.
pivotal_trials.result: Durable tumor & symptomatic response rate 34% (18/53) with siltuximab vs 0% (0/26) with placebo (95% CI of difference 11.1, 54.8; p=0.0012). Tumor response 38% vs 4%; median time to treatment failure not reached vs 134 days (HR 0.418, 95% CI 0.21 to 0.82; p<0.05).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>10% of patients) were rash, pruritus, upper respiratory tract infection, increased weight, and hyperuricemia. In Study 1, rash occurred in 28% (vs 12% placebo), pruritus 28% (vs 8%), upper respiratory tract infection 26% (vs 15%), and edema 26% (vs 27%).
target_moa: Siltuximab is an interleukin-6 (IL-6) antagonist: it binds IL-6 and prevents its binding to soluble or membrane-bound IL-6 receptor, thereby inhibiting IL-6-related signaling. Excess IL-6 is implicated in the systemic manifestations of Castleman's disease.
modality: mAb — full-length recombinant chimeric (human-mouse) IgG1 kappa monoclonal antibody directed to IL-6.

advisory_committee.vote: Not referred to an FDA advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues.

orphan_indication.text: Orphan drug designation for treatment of Castleman's disease, granted 5/26/06.

summary.text: SYLVANT (siltuximab) received full approval as a BLA under section 351(a) for HIV-negative, HHV-8-negative MCD, supported by a single phase 2 randomized placebo-controlled trial. The application had orphan drug designation (granted 5/26/06) and priority review, with a PMR to complete the long-term safety extension study CNTO328MCD2002.
